# Theme Configuration

## SWAPPSThemeProvider

The `SWAPPSThemeProvider` is the primary way to configure theming in a SWAPPS application. Wrap your application root with it to establish appearance and branding for all child components.

```tsx
import { SWAPPSThemeProvider } from '@swapps/ui';
import type { SWAPPSThemeConfig } from '@swapps/ui';

const themeConfig: SWAPPSThemeConfig = {
  appearance: 'dark',
  branding: {
    organizationName: 'SLAC',
    logoUrl: '/slac-logo.svg',
    primaryColor: '#8c1515',
    accentColor: '#b83a4b',
  },
};

function App() {
  return (
    <SWAPPSThemeProvider config={themeConfig}>
      <AppHeader appTitle="Beam Status" />
      {/* All child components inherit the theme */}
    </SWAPPSThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Configuration schema

```ts
interface SWAPPSThemeConfig {
  /** Light or dark mode */
  appearance: 'light' | 'dark';

  /** Organization identity and brand colors */
  branding: {
    /** Organization or laboratory name */
    organizationName: string;
    /** URL to the organization's logo */
    logoUrl?: string;
    /** Primary brand color (hex, e.g., '#0043ce') */
    primaryColor?: string;
    /** Secondary/accent brand color (hex) */
    accentColor?: string;
  };
}
```

### Defaults

If no configuration is provided, the system defaults to:

- Light appearance (`white` Carbon theme)
- No organization branding
- Standard Carbon semantic colors
- Default visualization palette

## Appearance

The `appearance` property maps to Carbon themes:

| Appearance | Carbon theme | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `'light'` | `white` | Light backgrounds, dark text |
| `'dark'` | `g100` | Dark backgrounds, light text |

The provider wraps children in Carbon's `Theme` component, so all Carbon tokens automatically adjust.

## Branding

Branding values are available to components through the `useSWAPPSBranding()` hook. Only **general UI components** (like `AppHeader`) consume branding — controls and charts ignore it.

| Property | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `organizationName` | `AppHeader`, navigation | Displayed as a label/prefix |
| `logoUrl` | `AppHeader` | Fallback logo when no `logo` prop is passed |
| `primaryColor` | General UI components | Applied via `--swapps-brand-primary` CSS variable |
| `accentColor` | General UI components | Applied via `--swapps-brand-accent` CSS variable |

## Consuming the theme in components

### Using hooks

```tsx
import { useSWAPPSTheme, useSWAPPSAppearance, useSWAPPSBranding } from '@swapps/ui';

function MyComponent() {
  // Full theme config + setter
  const { config, setConfig } = useSWAPPSTheme();

  // Just the appearance
  const appearance = useSWAPPSAppearance(); // 'light' | 'dark'

  // Just the branding
  const branding = useSWAPPSBranding();
  // { organizationName, logoUrl?, primaryColor?, accentColor? }
}
```

### Using CSS custom properties

Brand tokens are set as CSS custom properties on the provider's wrapper:

```css
.my-branded-element {
  background-color: var(--swapps-brand-primary, transparent);
  border-color: var(--swapps-brand-accent, transparent);
}
```

The fallback to `transparent` ensures that components without branding configuration render normally.

## Carbon theme mapping

The provider automatically selects the appropriate Carbon theme:

```ts
import { appearanceToCarbonTheme } from '@swapps/ui';

appearanceToCarbonTheme('light');            // 'white'
appearanceToCarbonTheme('dark');             // 'g100'
appearanceToCarbonTheme('light', 'raised');  // 'g10'
appearanceToCarbonTheme('dark', 'raised');   // 'g90'
```

## Contrast validation

The theme system includes utilities for validating brand color accessibility:

```tsx
import { isValidHexColor, meetsWCAG_AA, contrastRatio } from '@swapps/ui';

isValidHexColor('#ff0000');              // true
contrastRatio('#000000', '#ffffff');      // ~21
meetsWCAG_AA('#ffffff', '#0043ce');       // true (4.5:1 for normal text)
meetsWCAG_AA('#ffffff', '#0043ce', true); // true (3:1 for large text)
```

Use these when accepting user-configured brand colors to warn about insufficient contrast.

## Dynamic theming

The provider accepts an `onConfigChange` callback for applications that need dynamic theme switching:

```tsx
function App() {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(defaultConfig);

  return (
    <SWAPPSThemeProvider config={config} onConfigChange={setConfig}>
      <ThemeSwitcher />
      <AppContent />
    </SWAPPSThemeProvider>
  );
}
```
